response.sql: WITH fee_groups AS (SELECT f.orderslink, o.dealedge AS side, AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate > 0.0009 GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.dealedge), side_averages AS (SELECT side, AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) AS side_avg_net_fee_rate FROM fee_groups GROUP BY side) SELECT g.orderslink, g.side, g.avg_net_fee_rate, g.record_count, g.avg_net_fee_rate - s.side_avg_net_fee_rate AS difference FROM fee_groups AS g JOIN side_averages AS s ON g.side IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.side WHERE g.avg_net_fee_rate > s.side_avg_net_fee_rate ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
